guides.title: Start your superintendent workspace
guides.summary: Know where you are and how to reach each workspace.
guides.example: A superintendent checks Kings Course before planning today’s work.
guides.pitfall: A demo record is not a live course record.

steps.title: Choose the correct track
steps.text: Sign in with your approved account. Choose the course and track you intend to manage.
steps.example: Kings Ridge · Kings Course

steps.title: Find your tools
steps.text: Use the same-sized function tabs. The selected tab is highlighted; use Map to return to the overview.
steps.example: One active track at a time

steps.title: Try a task in the demo
steps.text: Use the fictional Test Drive to practice. End the walkthrough to use real demo controls.

steps.title: Confirm your context
steps.text: Read the course and track before saving. Demo changes are temporary; approved course changes are shared.
steps.example: Review before every course switch

steps.title: Busque las herramientas

guides.title: Report a broken sprinkler, valve or line
guides.summary: Turn a field problem into a traceable work order.
guides.example: A stuck head becomes an emergency inspection assigned to the irrigation technician.
guides.pitfall: A manager must approve closure before the repair highlight clears.

steps.title: Select the feature
steps.text: Open the relevant hole and tap the actual feature. Check its label.
steps.example: Sprinkler 3-01

steps.title: Describe the problem
steps.text: Enter symptoms and the exact location. Choose planned work or an unexpected emergency.
steps.example: Head will not retract; wet area beside green

steps.title: Plan the response
steps.text: Choose the work date, time, worker if known and estimated duration.
steps.example: Hole 3 · morning response

steps.title: Save the report
steps.text: Save the repair and confirm it appears red and in the work list. A report does not mean repaired.
steps.example: Open repair remains visible

es.title: Reporte un aspersor, válvula o tubería averiada

steps.title: Review or reverse

guides.title: Trace Ground Under Repair
guides.summary: Outline a visible, reversible repair area on phone or desktop.
guides.example: A drainage trench is outlined while the related work order stays open.
guides.pitfall: Drawing a boundary does not certify a Rules-of-Golf designation or survey its dimensions.

steps.title: Start at the affected hole
steps.text: Open Edit map and choose Draw repair area. Give the area a clear name.
steps.example: Hole 3 · drainage repair

steps.title: Draw the boundary
steps.text: Trace with one finger or the mouse, or choose corner-by-corner input.
steps.example: Tap around the damaged turf

steps.title: Refine the draft
steps.text: Undo the last point, clear the outline, or pause to pan and zoom. The boundary is not saved yet.
steps.example: Correct a corner without restarting

steps.title: Save the area
steps.text: Save repair area opens the full-map warning. Cancel keeps the draft; OK confirms it.
steps.example: An amber repair boundary appears

steps.title: Review later
steps.text: Use the Ground under repair layer. Reopen the area to redraw, move, archive or create a repair.
steps.example: Redraw after the repair area expands

es.title: Trace un área de terreno en reparación
es.summary: Instrucciones ilustradas para el superintendente. Siga cada paso y confirme el resultado en el recorrido correcto.

steps.title: Dibuje

steps.title: Refine el borrador

steps.example: Práctica: Deshaga un punto, borre el contorno o pause para mover y acercar el mapa.

steps.title: Guarde
steps.text: Lea la confirmación. Cancelar conserva el borrador; aceptar guarda en todas las vistas.

steps.example: Práctica: Lea la confirmación. Cancelar conserva el borrador; aceptar guarda en todas las vistas.

steps.title: Revise después

guides.title: Attach credential and training badges

steps.title: Open the profile
steps.text: Choose Open profile, then Attach a credential badge.
steps.example: Record the spray technician’s license

steps.title: Choose or customize
steps.text: Select a catalog credential or custom entry. Check that the record type and icon fit.
steps.example: License differs from a training card

steps.title: Record evidence and scope
steps.text: Enter issuer, jurisdiction or machine, issue date, expiry and your private evidence reference.
steps.example: Florida ornamental & turf; actual evidence reference

steps.title: Save and review status
steps.text: Choose Recorded or Course-reviewed against evidence. Expired and unknown-expiry records stay visibly distinct.
steps.example: Course review is not issuer verification

steps.title: Maintain the record

steps.title: Recognize the interruption
steps.text: If a save fails, do not assume the server received the work. Keep the original ticket open.
steps.example: A field note cannot reach the server.

steps.title: Keep only the local draft
steps.text: Use the draft option and read its device/account context. A draft is not a shared saved record.
steps.example: Private device notes, not an email sent.

steps.title: Review after reconnecting
steps.text: Read the draft and the current shared record before sending. Resolve changes rather than overwriting them.
steps.example: Someone else may have updated the ticket.

steps.title: Confirm the server result
steps.text: Check the saved status and current ticket history. Do not leave sensitive drafts on a shared phone.
steps.example: A local draft and confirmed save are different.

guides.pitfall: Completed or worked records are not draggable. Service reminders become dated work orders; repeat rules and meter thresholds stay unchanged.

steps.title: Choose a day, week or date range
steps.text: Use Day, Week, Month or Date range. Click a month date or a week heading to open the expanded day. Previous day and Next day keep you moving; print the current view when ready.
steps.example: View the shown work, totals and instructions; filters still apply.

steps.title: Drag or choose a date
steps.text: Drag the item with a mouse. On a phone, drag its ⠿ grip, or tap the grip to choose any date.
steps.example: Keep normal finger scrolling on the rest of the card.

steps.title: Review what will move
steps.text: The confirmation shows the old date and proposed date/time. Only one recurring occurrence moves; an event keeps its full span.
steps.example: Event preparation jobs stay put and may need review.

steps.title: Resolve conflicts
steps.text: Read the count and Review schedule conflicts list. Worker/equipment collisions and blocked event dates prevent conflicting job moves.
steps.example: Free-text named-crew reminder overlap requires review, not an inferred reservation.

steps.title: Save or undo
steps.text: Choose Save new date and time. Undo last calendar move reverses the most recent move if its record is unchanged. History is retained.
steps.example: A stale record or changed availability can prevent undo.

steps.title: Arrastre o elija fecha

steps.example: Arrastre con el ratón. En el teléfono use el asa ⠿ o tóquela para elegir una fecha. El resto de la tarjeta permite desplazarse.

steps.title: Revise el cambio

quiz.question: ¿El distintivo demuestra que el emisor verificó el registro?
quiz.answer: No. GolfOptix no verifica de manera independiente a la entidad emisora.

classes.title: Write a useful end-of-shift handover
classes.summary: A superintendent-led practical class with examples, a check for understanding and a printable handout.

steps.title: Review assigned work
steps.text: Open the day list and distinguish completed, in-progress and awaiting approval.
steps.example: Four jobs with different states

steps.title: Write what happened
steps.text: Record observations, actual actions and remaining issues on each relevant ticket.
steps.example: Do not copy a planned action as if completed

steps.title: Request the right next step
steps.text: Submit closure only where ready; tell the superintendent about the rest.
steps.example: An unfinished diagnosis stays open

steps.title: Prepare tomorrow’s discussion
steps.text: The manager reviews the next day and copies only the appropriate schedule pattern.
steps.example: Include a clear follow-up location

quiz.question: What is the difference between draft closed and closed?
quiz.answer: Draft closed is awaiting manager approval; closed has the recorded approval.

quiz.answer: La solicitud espera aprobación; el cierre tiene la aprobación registrada del responsable.
